title: Cheese sandwich
summary: Bread, butter, cheese. A classic no-cook demo.
source: Written for REMY by Claude as a simple demo. Waiting for Matthew's review.
notes: Slicing cheese: keep your fingers tucked in a claw grip and cut down onto the board.
ingredients: Optional: pickle, tomato slices or lettuce

steps.instruction: Spread butter thinly over one side of each slice of bread, right to the edges.
looks_right: thin, even butter to the crusts
looks_wrong: torn bread (butter too hard: soften it first)

steps.instruction: Slice the cheese on the board. Keep your fingers curled like a claw, away from the blade.
looks_wrong: fingertips flat in front of the blade

steps.instruction: Lay the cheese (and any extras) on one slice, buttered side up. Put the other slice on top, buttered side down, and cut it in half.
looks_right: cheese covering the bread to the edges
looks_wrong: fillings sliding out of the sides
